theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_sch_bu_hds_compact_subseq
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α K M : ℝ) (S : Set (Rn n)) (g : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)), 0 < α → 0 ≤ K → IsCompact S → (∀ j, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖g j z‖ ≤ M) → (∀ j, ∀ z ∈ S, ∀ z' ∈ S, ‖g j z - g j z'‖ ≤ K * ‖z - z'‖ ^ α) → ∃ (χ : ℕ → ℕ) (G : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)), StrictMono χ ∧ TendstoUniformlyOn (fun j => g (χ j)) G atTop S
